description: Issue summary: On NovaSearch's private VPC deployment, nightly SCIM sync and internal scheduled workers started failing with authorization errors after an ingress proxy upgrade. Impact: Multiple scheduled sync jobs (user/group sync, model metadata sync) are repeatedly failing and retrying, causing partial staleness in NovaSearch's RBAC cache and elevated operational load. Environment: private deployment in us-east-1; ingress v2.3.1 rolled out cluster-wide on 2026-03-09; identity-proxy v1.9 (token-exchange + header injection) in use. Observed behavior: worker processes receive 401/403 with message indicating missing scope (e.g. "missing_scope: sync:write"), despite service-account tokens showing required scopes when introspected. Expected behavior: ephemeral service-account tokens minted for scheduled jobs should carry the full scope set and be preserved through ingress/header passthrough so scheduled workers can perform SCIM and metadata writes.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a scheduled sync job using ephemeral service-account tokens in a private VPC with identity-proxy enabled.
2) Trigger the job (manually or wait for nightly window).
3) Observe failed HTTP calls from worker to SCIM API with 401/403 and 'missing_scope' error in response body.
4) Introspect the bearer token at the identity provider: token shows 'sync:read sync:write' in scopes claim.
5) Inspect request headers hitting backend: X-Remote-Scopes header truncated or missing the 'sync:write' scope.
6) Roll back ingress to previous version — failures stop (customer-reported reproduction).
logs: [2026-03-10T02:14:05Z] identity-proxy introspection OK token_id=svc-ephem-3 scopes=\"sync:read sync:write\"
[2026-03-10T02:14:05Z] ingress-nginx: 'X-Remote-Scopes' header length 512 truncated to 256 due to new header-size-limit
[2026-03-10T02:14:05Z] backend auth middleware: computed scopes from header=\"sync:read\" -> denied
investigation_notes: Support confirmed failures started immediately after ingress v2.3.1 rollout on 2026-03-09 (customer reported timeline).

Reproduced in a sanitized staging replica by applying the same ingress configuration and identity-proxy token exchange: when ingress header_size limit set lower, X-Remote-Scopes is truncated and 'sync:write' is dropped.

Introspection shows token itself contains full scopes; problem appears to be header transport/truncation between identity-proxy and backend (ingress truncation + header-writes in newer ingress release).

Hypothesis: ingress v2.3.1 tightened per-header size limits; identity-proxy writes scopes as a single space-separated header rather than separate headers; long scope lists exceed new limit and get truncated mid-scope causing missing required scopes.
Temporary mitigation tested: configure identity-proxy to emit multiple 'X-Remote-Scope-*' headers for long lists and backend adapter to merge them -> scheduled syncs succeed in staging.

Long-term fix options: a) increase per-header size limit in ingress config, b) switch to chunked scope headers (identity-proxy change), c) canonicalize server to verify token via introspection on backend rather than relying solely on forwarded headers.
comments: Customer (NovaSearch-Trevor): 'We started seeing hundreds of sync failures after the ingress upgrade. Rolling back ingress fixed it immediately. How can we avoid this on upgrades?',

Support (Aisha): 'Thanks Trevor — we've started triage and can confirm header truncation in our repro. We're coordinating with infra to propose a short-term ingress config change to restore stability.',

SRE (Daniel): 'Reproduced locally; ingress v2.3.1 defaults header-size to 256 for upstream. Patch proposal: set proxy-buffer-size and large_client_header_buffers to accommodate typical X-Remote-* payloads. Will test impact on memory.',
Customer (Trevor): 'Patch looked good in our test cluster. We'd prefer a fix that avoids rolling back ingress in future. Can you deliver backported change to identity-proxy too?',
Support (Aisha): 'Working with devs to prepare an identity-proxy update to emit multiple scope headers and a backend guard to merge them. ETA initial PR within 48 hours.'
action_items: SRE: test ingress buffer increase patch across canary nodes and monitor memory/latency (assigned to Daniel).
Engineering: implement identity-proxy header chunking and backend merge logic (PR target: 48 hours).
Support: coordinate a scheduled configuration change with NovaSearch to apply ingress buffer increases and validate nightly job stability.
Postmortem: create runbook entry for 'scope-header-truncation' and add pre-upgrade checklist for ingress header-size impacts.
